item: GET /api/wiki/lane/status never makes a poll wait on a scan: it answers from the kept figures and one background read replaces them
summary: Windows run 2026-11-07: 9,170 polls averaged 1.47 s (p95 5.5 s, max 19.8 s) and 139 of the 152 stalls over 5 s named this route: the poll that found the 30 s window passed held the lock through three COUNT scans of the 1.8 GB lane and every poll behind it waited. Now, once a measured answer exists for today, a poll past the window is answered at once (cached true, the real age_s, refreshing true) and ONE background read replaces it; only the first poll of a process and of a new local day read for themselves; a failed refresh drops the kept answer so the next poll says what happened.
